title: Actual RibaMod groundwater transfer activated after the accepted daily allocation

sequencing.rationale: Correct the 20E timing assumption prospectively, before any active-transfer runtime output.

modflow.mapping: single passive Drainage bound index 0 -> Ribasim Basin index 0

independent_continuous_reference.equation_segments_2_4: A dh/dt = 32 + 8 - 32*phi(h-0.99), 6-24 h; allocation remains the t=0 root=32, external=0 decision
independent_continuous_reference.final_ledger: 32 m3 fixed source + 6 m3 post-allocation groundwater drainage = root supplied + Basin storage gain

hypotheses: The first 0-6 h product step has zero MF6 drainage, so the t=0 Ribasim allocation remains root=32 m3/day and external=0.
The passive MF6 drainage activates only after the first accepted 6-hour boundary and then transfers approximately 8 m3/day to the Ribasim Basin.
Because t=6, 12 and 18 h are not fixed allocation.dt=24 h boundaries, the newly arriving physical groundwater water does not trigger a new UserDemand allocation during day 1.
External-demand cumulative supply remains zero through 24 h.
Groundwater cumulative transfer is 0, 2, 4 and 6 m3 at the accepted 6-hour endpoints.
Basin level and root cumulative physical supply follow the frozen piecewise continuous reference within tolerance.
The one-day ledger closes: 32 m3 source + 6 m3 groundwater transfer = root supplied + Basin storage gain.

This demonstrates that physical transfer arriving after an accepted management decision changes physical state immediately without retroactive management reallocation inside the current allocation window.
forbidden: no groundwater drainage during the first 0-6 h MF6 product step
no manual UserDemand reallocation at t=6,12,18 h
no active river-stage feedback in this work unit
no changing activation time, transfer magnitude, references or tolerances after runtime output

technical_representation_amendment.reason: Pinned iMOD-Python validates active Drainage conductance as strictly positive. Representing the frozen zero-first-step flux with conductance=0 would therefore be a package-validity artifact.
technical_representation_amendment.executable_representation: conductance fixed at 16 m2/day; drain elevation equals fixed head 0.5 m during 0-6 h and switches to 0.0 m from 6 h onward
